correctness.rationale: The frozen text falsely calls b_a involutive and uses that in its proof (already b_a(b_a(0))=−2a/(1+a²)≠0). The repair replaces it with the actual inverse (z+a)/(1+az), proves bounded composition for both signs of the Poisson weight, and corrects the frozen verification note that overstated what finite-section checks test. The final finding retains the same operator and band/norm formulas. Independently, pushing normalized circle measure forward under b_a gives P_(−a); its moments give H_mn=(−a)^|m−n|. Grouping coefficients into even/odd pairs gives the stated continuous Hermitian symbol: the even-row odd-column coefficient at block offset k is (−a)^|2k−1|. Its geometric series yields exactly the displayed off-diagonal, and multiplying the proposed inverse gives I using (1+a²)²−a²|1+e^(iθ)|²=1−2a²cosθ+a⁴. With both weights positive, the larger inverse-symbol eigenvalue grows and the smaller decreases with |cos(θ/2)|; reciprocating gives both claimed bands with their endpoint order. At a zero weight there is a zero band plus one diagonal range. Essential inclusion in both directions follows from the Toeplitz product modulo compacts and weakly null polarized Hardy kernels, as reconstructed in the repair. Compression bounds and inclusion of both essential endpoints give the true norm and lower Gram edge; the Calkin identities give the same essential and inverse norms. The actual inverse automorphism completes the t≠±1 invertibility argument; for t=±1 its composition with twice a parity projection has closed range and infinite kernel. The repair concerns essential bands, not the full spectrum inside a gap.
residual_risks: The optional numerical program is representative and finite; no gap-eigenvalue census follows from it or is asserted.

value.rationale: For a natural two-symbol family, the exact ends give both conditioning and its essential counterpart, while the internal edges determine when distinct spectral bands exist for complex t. These are operationally different data from boundedness, compactness or a single-symbol norm, and the closed-form gap law provides parameter information beyond the abstract existence of a Toeplitz symbol.
